sql: SELECT coalesce(json_agg(q),'[]'::json) FROM (SELECT r.id,r.revision,r.evidence_status_current,t.status,t.execution_state,(SELECT count(*) FROM public.operation_evidence_events ee WHERE ee.receipt_id=r.id AND ee.event_kind='satisfied') as satisfied_events FROM public.operation_execution_receipts r JOIN public.operation_task_instances t ON t.id=r.task_instance_id WHERE r.id='bbdb39be-9fc8-4690-9fb4-d73d4100718c') q;
